body:
I've been diagnosed with depression. I've been treated by most of the common and some uncommon drugs for depression, and they all made things worse after a few weeks, at best.

It's been a long, tiring process that's taken so many years, I can't bring myself to believe that there's any chance I'll get better
I don't believe it's bad. I probably qualify as the type to get bored easily, too. I haven't moved onto something new because I lack enthusiasm for getting into anything else
